official_sources.title: FSSAI Chapter 2.4 — Cereals and Cereal Products

common_rules.text: Food additives are permitted only where allowed by the relevant Chapter 2.4 standard and Appendix A.
Where the Chapter 2.4 standard refers to Appendix B, the applicable microbiological requirements also apply.
Applicable products must comply with the Food Safety and Standards (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Regulations.
General Labelling and Display Regulations apply in addition to product-specific declarations.

standards.name: Wheat Flour (Atta) and Resultant Wheat Flour (Resultant Atta)
quality_rules: Free from abnormal flavours, odours, living insects and filth.

standards.name: Protein Rich Wheat Flour (Protein Prachur Atta)

composition.parameter: Urease activity when soy flour is used

source_verified_identity.description: Protein rich wheat flour uses wheat flour as the principal flour plus no more than 15% permitted additions.
source_verified_identity.contamination_scope_verified: Aflatoxin B1 harmonized official article only

standards.name: Protein Rich Refined Wheat Flour (Protein Prachur Maida)

source_verified_identity.description: Protein rich refined wheat flour uses maida (refined wheat flour) plus up to 15% allowed protein enrichment additions.
source_verified_identity.contamination_scope_verified: Aflatoxin B1 harmonized official article only

standards.name: Durum Wheat Maida
standards.definition: Refined flour prepared from durum wheat (Triticum durum Desf.) by milling with bran and germ essentially removed.

source_verified_identity.definition: Product obtained by grinding dehusked Bengal gram (Cicer arietinum).

standards.name: Pearl Barley (Jau)
quality_rules: Made from sound and clean barley.
Other foodgrains not more than 1% by weight.
Free from insect/fungus infestation and rodent contamination.

standards.name: Food Grains

general_limits.parameter: Total foreign matter + other edible grains + damaged grains

quality_rules: Food grains for human consumption shall be whole or broken kernels of cereals, millets and pulses and comply with the applicable grain-specific table.

standards.name: Any other foodgrains
standards.definition: Other food grains not specified in preceding named FSSAI 2.4.6 grain clauses. Do not apply this residual standard to a grain with a specific FSSAI standard or to unrelated seed identities without verification.

general_limits.condition: Measured after heating pulverised grains at 130–133°C for two hours.

general_limits.parameter: Total foreign matter, other edible grains and damaged grains

standards.applicability_note: Applies to the exact FoSCoS 'Any other foodgrains' catalogue identity only. Specific-standard raw grains and Chia seeds, Quinoa, Triticale or grain derivatives are not automatically reclassified under this residual clause.

standards.name: Unprocessed whole raw pulses (not for direct human consumption)
standards.definition: Unprocessed whole raw pulses (not for direct human consumption). Other applicable standards under FSSR 2.4.6 continue to apply.

general_limits.parameter: Inorganic matter and impurities of animal origin within foreign matter

standards.name: Oats
standards.definition: Dried mature Avena sativa or Avena byzantina grains, wholesome, free of toxic seeds, live insects and visible mould.

general_limits.parameter: Impurities of animal origin within foreign matter

standards.applicability_note: Use only exact Oats grain identity. Maintain FoSCoS parent FSSR 2.4.6 for catalogue, apply this specific subclause for composition. No contaminant, pesticide MRL, additive, microbiology or full product clearance is implied.

standards.name: Quinoa
standards.definition: Dried mature Chenopodium quinoa grain with saponin removed by washing, scouring, dehulling or another suitable process.
standards.applicability_note: Use only exact Quinoa grain identity. Maintain FoSCoS parent FSSR 2.4.6 for catalogue, apply this specific subclause for composition. No contaminant, pesticide MRL, additive, microbiology or full product clearance is implied.

standards.name: Durum Wheat
standards.definition: Dried mature Triticum durum Desf. grains, free of abnormal flavours/odours, live insects and mites.

general_limits.parameter: Impurities of animal origin within extraneous matter

standards.applicability_note: Use only exact Durum Wheat grain identity. Maintain FoSCoS parent FSSR 2.4.6 for catalogue, apply this specific subclause for composition. No contaminant, pesticide MRL, additive, microbiology or full product clearance is implied.

standards.name: Pulses — Whole, Dehusked and Split
standards.definition: FSSAI 2.4.6(22) covers whole or shelled (de-husked) or split pulses, including mixtures of listed pulses. The rule excludes toxic or noxious seeds and added colouring matter.
named_pulse_families: Bengal gram (Chana, Chick pea, Kabuli Chana, Chhole, Hara Chana)

variant_requirements.condition: Maximum; choose whether the pulse retains its seed coat

general_limits.condition: Of which mineral matter ≤0.25% and animal-origin impurities ≤0.10%

standards.source_page_range: Current Chapter 2.4 Version 4 (07.05.2025), PDF pages 15–17, clause 2.4.6(22)
standards.applicability_note: Only listed pulse identities and genuine whole/dehusked/split forms; not automatically applicable to besan, sattu or pulse flours.

standards.name: Millets — Whole or Dehulled Grains
standards.definition: Millets standard for whole or dehulled grains, including Finger Millet (Ragi or Mandua), Eleusine coracana.

general_limits.condition: Both whole grains and dehulled grains
Includes maximum 0.25% mineral matter and maximum 0.10% impurities of animal origin

general_limits.parameter: Impurities of animal origin within extraneous matter

quality_rules: Applies to whole or dehulled millets including Finger Millet (Ragi or Mandua), Eleusine coracana.
Must be free from poisonous, toxic, noxious, or obnoxious seeds, added colouring matter, rodent hair and excreta.
Ragi Flour is separately standardized under FSSAI 2.4.34 and shall not inherit whole-grain limits as its sole specification.
standards.validation_state: Specific Millet 2.4.6(23) limits transcribed from official FSSAI Chapter 2.4 Version 4.

standards.name: Rice
standards.definition: Rice shall be whole and broken kernels obtained from Oryza sativa L.

variant_requirements.condition: Not more than; impurities of animal origin including dead insects shall not be more than 0.1%

variant_requirements.parameter: Damaged Kernels including Heat-Damaged and Pin Point damaged

regulatory_notes: Clause 2.4.6(24) contains separate limits for four rice types; PMSV must not collapse them into one generic numeric limit.
The row formerly appearing between damaged kernels and immature kernels is omitted in the current consolidated text.

standards.name: Rice Flour for Preparation of Fortified Rice Kernel (FRK)
standards.regulatory_note: The 2023 direction withdrew the Yeast & Mould Count and Aerobic Plate Count parameters previously listed for this rice flour.

standards.name: Maize Starch
standards.definition: Starch obtained from maize (Zea mays L.); odourless, white, free-flowing powder without added colour, flavours or other chemicals and free from dirt, insects, larvae and extraneous matter.

standards.name: Corn Flakes
standards.definition: Product obtained from dehulled, degermed and cooked corn and processed into flakes.

standards.name: Custard Powder

composition.parameter: Total ash excluding added common salt

permitted_ingredients: small quantities of edible starches from arrowroot, potato or jowar

standards.name: Pasta / Macaroni Products
standards.note: Product-specific permitted optional ingredients and quality limits are retained in the source standard and must be applied before full validation.

formulation_rules.condition: Except starch naturally present in cocoa powder

source_verified_identity.description: Malted milk food requires a malted cereal/grain or cereal malt extract along with milk/milk powder.
source_verified_identity.contamination_scope_verified: Aflatoxin B1 harmonized official article only

source_verified_identity.description: Malt food requires malt from germinated cereal and/or grain-legume seeds and other cereal/legume flour.
source_verified_identity.contamination_scope_verified: Aflatoxin B1 harmonized official article only

source_verified_identity.description: Malt extract requires sound malted grains of cereals (such as barley, wheat or millets).
source_verified_identity.contamination_scope_verified: Aflatoxin B1 harmonized official article only

standards.name: Starchy Foods — Arrowroot / Tapioca Sago / Palm Sago Starch

variants.name: Arrowroot
variants.definition: Separated and purified starch from Maranta arundinacea or Curcuma angustifolia.

standards.name: Biscuit
standards.definition: Baked product, leavened or non-leavened, coated or uncoated, including wafers, cookies, crackers, centre-filled, enrobed, sandwich and crème biscuits.
permitted_ingredient_groups: cereals and cereal products including millets/pulses/legumes
standards.source_note: Detailed ingredient and compositional provisions remain linked to clause 2.4.15(1).

standards.name: Bread and Bread-Type Products
standards.definition: Baked product prepared from atta and/or maida with water, salt, yeast or other fermentative/leavening medium; includes breads and rusks.

official_finished_cereal_identity_source.exact_product_definition: Baked product prepared from atta (whole wheat flour) and/or maida (refined wheat flour), water, salt, and yeast or another fermentative/leavening medium; includes breads and rusks.

standards.name: Soybean
standards.definition: Soybean obtained from plants of Glycine max (L.) Merr.; the applicable grain-quality requirements are set in clause 2.4.19.

source_verified_oilseed_identity.note: Mandatory oilseed ingredient/product identity supports separate FSSAI Version IX Aflatoxin B1 article check only. No Total Aflatoxins or MRL/metal/general PASS.

standards.name: Whole Maize (Corn) Flour
standards.definition: Whole maize flour prepared from fully mature, sound, ungerminated whole kernels of maize by grinding so that the whole grain is represented.

standards.name: Wheat Protein Products including Wheat Gluten
Durum Wheat Semolina and Whole Durum Wheat Semolina
Degermed Maize (Corn) Meal and Maize (Corn) Grits
standards.particle_size_rules: Product-specific sieve requirements apply to meal and grits as specified in the standard.

standards.name: Couscous
standards.definition: Product obtained from durum wheat semolina whose particles are bound by adding potable water and processed as specified.

standards.name: Tempe
permitted_ingredients: Rhizopus spp. mould inoculum with cooked rice powder, rice bran powder and/or wheat bran powder

source_verified_identity.definition: Tempe is a fermented soybean cake prepared from dehulled boiled soybeans with Rhizopus spp.; soybean is specified as an ingredient.

standards.name: Textured Soy Protein (Soy Bari / Soy Chunks / Soy Granules)
standards.definition: Product obtained by extrusion of defatted soy flour or grits.

source_verified_identity.definition: Textured Soy Protein is obtained by extrusion of defatted soy flour or soy grits.

standards.name: Wheat Bran
standards.definition: Outer layer of wheat grain consisting of combined pericarp and aleurone with possible adhering endosperm.
quality_rules: Free from musty/stale odour, sourness, lumps, dirt, metallic pieces, fungus and insect infestation.

source_verified_identity.definition: Non-fermented soybean products must contain soybean and/or soy derivatives as main ingredients; soybean beverages, soybean curd (including compressed curd and tofu) and dehydrated curd film are specifically described.
source_verified_identity.condition: Aflatoxin B1 requires separate source validation for both oilseed/ready-to-eat and composite-food articles; other contaminants remain to be assessed.

source_verified_identity.definition: Roasted Bengal gram flour (Chana Sattu) obtained from clean, washed, dried and sound grains of Bengal gram (Cicer arietinum) after grinding in roasted form.

standards.name: Ragi Flour
standards.definition: Flour obtained from dried mature grains of Eleusine coracana L. Gaertn. by milling.

standards.name: Breakfast Cereal
standards.definition: Ready-to-eat and quick or regular cooking cereal products including puffed, powdered, flaked, multigrain, soy/bran-based, granola, cereal bars, muesli and extruded cereal products.

formulation_rules.parameter: Whole grain in a product labelled wholegrain breakfast cereal

ingredient_rules: Cereals/pseudocereals/grains taken together must appear as the first ingredient in the ingredient list.

source_verified_identity.exact_food_form: dehusked yellow peas milled to powder

standards.name: Multigrain Flour (Atta)
label_rules: Declare percentage of wheat flour (atta) in the product.

standards.name: Mixed Millet Flour
standards.definition: Flour obtained by milling/grinding a blend of clean millets/pseudomillets or blending their flours.

variants.name: Fermented Soybean Curd (S. thermophilus + L. bulgaricus)

exact_variants.catalogue_name: Fermented Soybean Curd (made with S. thermophillus + L. bulgaricus)
exact_variants.standard_variant: Fermented Soybean Curd (S. thermophilus + L. bulgaricus)

standards.name: Papad / Papadam
label_rules: Product name may include vernacular/common/traditional/major-ingredient name in addition to 'Papad'.

standards.name: Formulated supplements for children
standards.scope: Children above 24 months up to 36 months.
standards.description: Nutritionally appropriate supplementary food intended to complement family foods by providing energy and nutrients that may be lacking or insufficient.
permitted_ingredient_groups: Oil seed flours and oil seed protein products
Permitted probiotic/prebiotic ingredients subject to applicable FSSAI provisions

formulation_rules.value: Use appropriately processed soya with reduced anti-nutritional factors and low phytoestrogens

label_rules: The product name shall indicate that it is a formulated supplement for children.
Do not present the product as 'Energy food' or 'Health food'.
The label shall not refer to malnourished children.
Declare major protein sources and that the product is recommended for children above 24 months up to 36 months.
Provide preparation/use instructions and the prescribed feeding/discard guidance.
